mentions.name: 144-rectangle day visualizer
mentions.description: This app visualizes the day as 144 rectangles, each representing 10 minutes of the day, built in the same spirit as a time-visualizing app.
mentions.source_excerpt: i built something similar in spirit a while back, but instead of a bar, it uses 144 rectangles, each representing 10 minutes of your day: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=30881096
